paraphrase: The first vajra topic, the ground: its essence is primordially pure, its nature spontaneously present, its compassion all-pervading; it is neither saṃsāra nor nirvāṇa and is described as a youthful vase body — luminosity enclosed within.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase).

paraphrase: How delusion arises: when the ground-appearances emerge from the ground through the eight gateways of spontaneous presence, not recognizing them as one's own display is ignorance (in three kinds), and the dualistic apprehension of self and other unfolds into the realms of saṃsāra.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase).

paraphrase: The abode of wisdom in the body: wisdom dwells in the heart (the precious citta palace) as the luminous essence, connects through the crystal kati channel to the eyes, and manifests through the lamps (sgron ma); the channels, winds and essences are the body's support of the path.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase). Topic numbers 3-5 approximate. Doctrinal anatomy only; the practices built on it are restricted (prc:togal).
